title: Crypto Security Gap Heatmap
purpose: Group 12 identified crypto security gaps across four architectural layers (Smart Contract, Backend Verification, Frontend, Infrastructure) with severity color coding.
audience: Blockchain engineers, security team, backend developers, CTO
description: Twelve crypto security gaps organized by layer. Smart Contract Layer (3 medium gaps): immutable contract with no upgrade mechanism, no emergency pause, missing PaymentType fields stored on-chain. Backend Verification Layer (4 gaps — 3 critical, 1 high): sandbox 0x0000 bypass skips on-chain verification, placeholder event topics (hardcoded placeholders), hardcoded contract addresses with no address validation, no RPC API keys with no rate limiting. Frontend Layer (3 gaps — 2 critical, 1 high): mocked wallet returns fake 0x0000 txHash, dead Stripe endpoints return 404, raw fetch bypass skips apiClient auth headers. Infrastructure Layer (2 critical gaps): mocked off-ramp returns fake transfer ID, no webhooks uses poll-based verification only.
preconditions: Smart contract is deployed on Base network
Backend crypto payment service is operational
postconditions: All 12 crypto security gaps are identified and severity-rated
Critical gaps requiring immediate remediation are highlighted

nodes.label: 1. Immutable — No upgrade mechanism
nodes.description: Medium: Smart contract has no proxy pattern, UUPS, or any upgrade mechanism

nodes.label: 2. No pause — No emergency stop
nodes.description: Medium: No emergency pause mechanism if vulnerability is discovered

nodes.label: 3. Missing type fields — PaymentType not stored on-chain
nodes.description: Medium: Events don't distinguish payment types at the contract level

nodes.label: 4. Sandbox 0x0000 bypass — Skips on-chain verification
nodes.description: Critical: Any 0x0000-prefixed txHash bypasses blockchain verification entirely

nodes.label: 5. Placeholder event topics — Hardcoded placeholders
nodes.description: Critical: Event topic hashes are placeholder values, not real keccak256 hashes

nodes.label: 6. Hardcoded contract addresses — No address validation
nodes.description: Critical: Contract addresses are hardcoded fallbacks with no environment override

nodes.label: 7. No RPC API keys — Public endpoint, no rate limiting
nodes.description: High: Public RPC endpoints with no API key authentication or rate limiting

nodes.label: 8. Mocked wallet — Fake 0x0000 txHash
nodes.description: Critical: useCryptoWallet returns hardcoded addresses and fake balance of 1250 USDC

nodes.label: 9. Dead Stripe endpoints — Frontend calls return 404
10. Raw fetch bypass — Skips apiClient auth headers
nodes.description: High: useCryptoWallet uses raw fetch() instead of apiClient, bypassing auth interceptor

nodes.label: 11. Mocked off-ramp — Fake transfer ID, no real integration
nodes.description: Critical: processDebitCardOffRamp returns mock response, no actual payout API called

nodes.label: 12. No webhooks — Poll-based verification only
nodes.description: Critical: No blockchain event webhooks — poll-based eth_getTransactionReceipt only

connections.label: Smart Contract gaps feed into Backend verification
Frontend mocks lead to Infrastructure gaps

securityConsiderations: CRITICAL: Sandbox 0x0000 bypass renders blockchain verification completely ineffective
CRITICAL: Placeholder event topics mean log parsing relies on to-address matching, not topic filtering
CRITICAL: Hardcoded contract addresses with no validation could reference wrong contracts
CRITICAL: Mocked wallet and off-ramp means no real crypto/fiat flow works in production
CRITICAL: No webhooks means verification is poll-based and may miss transactions
HIGH: No RPC API keys means public endpoints vulnerable to abuse
HIGH: Raw fetch bypass means frontend requests lack auth headers and error handling
performanceConsiderations: Poll-based verification (eth_getTransactionReceipt) adds latency per check
No webhooks means the system cannot react to blockchain events in real-time
annotations: Smart Contract Layer: 3 medium gaps (immutable, no pause, missing type fields)
Backend Verification Layer: 4 gaps (3 critical, 1 high) — sandbox bypass, placeholder topics, hardcoded addresses, no API keys
Frontend Layer: 3 gaps (2 critical, 1 high) — mocked wallet, dead Stripe, raw fetch bypass
Infrastructure Layer: 2 critical gaps — mocked off-ramp, no webhooks
Total: 7 critical, 2 high, 3 medium across 12 gaps
